Extract time-locked physical fish positions under all joint scenarios

Source: R/joint-scene-cloud.R
aqt_joint_scene_cloud.Rd

Uses the most recent observation in each coherent optical/identity scenario, retaining only finite and explicitly observed XYZ no older than max_age_s. Missing or occluded fish are NOT backfilled. Because discrete fish-ID alternatives can be multimodal, returns every observed XYZ draw rather than fitting an unwarranted Gaussian ellipsoid. Summarizes per-label visibility and marginal coordinate quantiles only.

Usage

aqt_joint_scene_cloud(
  scenarios,
  session_id,
  frame_s,
  max_age_s = 0.2,
  probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95)
)

Arguments

scenarios

An aqt_joint_refractive_scenarios from the validated joint pixel/flat-glass/identity scenario generator.

session_id

Exactly one preexisting session/tank recording ID.

frame_s

Requested recording time in seconds.

max_age_s

Maximum permitted age of the last observed fish.

probs

Three increasing marginal descriptive quantiles, default 5th, 50th, 95th percentiles. NOT confidence limits.

Value

aqt_joint_scene_cloud with every 3D sample, visibility counts, optional label assignment-change frequencies and units.
